prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a square waist-up character profile illustration of ONE original adult male Beorning for The One Ring. Latest attached book illustration is the STYLE and clothing reference only; do not copy its figures or group arrangement. Match the approved portrait collection: warm muted reddish umber fine pen/pencil contours, medium density directional hatching and crosshatching, small deep brown shadow pockets, broad pale ivory paper highlights. Traditional expressive illustrated character anatomy, midway between sparse outline and fully rendered realism.
Subject: an exceptionally broad-shouldered powerful human man in his forties, thick neck, large strong hands, shaggy shoulder-length hair and a full unruly beard. Stern watchful eyes, strong blunt nose, weathered face with quiet protective resolve. A Beorning homesteader and wilderness guardian, clothed in a plain heavy belted wool tunic, simple leather wristbands, and a rough fur-edged mantle over one shoulder. His tunic sleeves are rolled enough to show strong forearms. One hand rests naturally on the wooden haft of a practical large axe beside his torso; a portion of the plain axe head visible at the lower side, safely at rest. No ornate armor or royal decoration. Make his stocky powerful silhouette distinct from the slender elf and cloaked ranger portraits. Three-quarter view, face centered and clearly readable, enough margin above head for avatar cropping, include torso and hand.
Draw the beard in distinct locks with cream gaps between brown hatched pockets. Selective facial lines and short hatch marks model brow, cheek planes, nose and jaw. Fur indicated with grouped irregular strokes rather than each individual hair. Cloth fold hatching follows form. Muted warm brown marks on very light cream paper, mostly blank background with a few faint hatch strokes near shoulders fading away. No scenery, text, frame, watermark, photographic actor likeness, smooth blended shading, pores, gray graphite wash, thick cartoon outlines, full color or large solid fills. ONE character only, human appearance, no bear transformation. Square composition intended 640x640 WebP profile.
